test_astype_nan_to_int: test that casting Categorical or CategoricalIndex with NaN values to int raises ValueError or TypeError
test_astype_category_to_extension_dtype: test that casting a Categorical to datetime64, timedelta, period, interval, or nullable Int64 extension dtypes round-trips correctly
test_astype_str_int_categories_to_nullab: test that casting a Categorical with string integer categories to nullable Int64 converts values correctly
test_astype_category_copy_false_nocopy_c: test that casting a Categorical to category with copy=False shares memory on codes while copy=True does not
test_astype_category: test that casting a Categorical to another CategoricalDtype preserves or changes categories and ordered flag as expected
